# Reviewer rules

Generated by `npm run review-scripts -- --rules-md` from `src/reviewer/reviewSource.ts` - do not edit by hand;
`tests/meta/reviewer.spec.ts` fails if this file drifts from the code.

Suppress one finding with `// review-ignore RULE-ID: <reason why this case is different>` on the same or previous line (a missing reason is ignored).

| Rule | Severity | Category | What it flags | Why it matters |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `SYNC-001` | error | synchronization | Hard sleep (waitForTimeout) | A fixed sleep is either too short (flaky) or too long (slow) and never proves the app is ready. |
| `SYNC-002` | warning | synchronization | networkidle wait | networkidle never settles on apps with polling, websockets or analytics, and says nothing about what the user can see. |
| `SYNC-003` | warning | synchronization | Legacy waitForSelector / waitForNavigation | Deprecated, element-handle based waits; locators and web-first assertions re-resolve and retry. |
| `SYNC-004` | warning | synchronization | Non-retrying read inside expect() | expect(await x.isVisible()) reads the state once, immediately, and never retries - the classic source of intermittent failures. |
| `SYNC-005` | warning | synchronization | Control flow on a non-waiting check | if (await x.isVisible()) decides at one instant; whether the element is already there is a race. |
| `SYNC-006` | error | synchronization | Event/response wait registered after the trigger | If the response or popup arrives before the wait starts, the wait times out even though the app behaved correctly. |
| `SYNC-007` | info | synchronization | Very long explicit timeout | A timeout of a minute or more on a single step usually hides a slow screen or a wrong locator. |
| `SYNC-008` | warning | synchronization | Step triggers a result but the next step does not verify it | Saving, submitting, searching or logging in changes the page asynchronously; acting again without checking the outcome builds on an unknown state. |
| `SYNC-009` | warning | synchronization | force: true | force skips Playwright's actionability checks (visible, enabled, not covered) - it turns a real readiness problem into a silent one. |
| `VER-001` | error | verification | Test has no assertion | A test that cannot fail proves nothing. (Reported as a warning instead when the test calls page-object helpers or functions whose bodies the reviewer cannot see: they may assert inside.) |
| `VER-002` | warning | verification | Test ends on an action | The last thing the test does is never checked, so the outcome the manual case describes is not verified. |
| `VER-003` | warning | verification | Only trivial assertions | toBeTruthy/toBeDefined on a value, or expect(true), cannot detect most real defects. |
| `VER-004` | error | verification | Unawaited web-first assertion | Without await the assertion is never waited for; the test can finish (and pass) before it is evaluated. |
| `VER-005` | warning | verification | Only 'nothing is shown' is asserted | Absence of an error is not presence of success; pair it with a positive assertion of the real outcome. |
| `DATA-001` | error | test-data | Hardcoded credential or secret | Secrets in test code end up in source control, logs and traces. |
| `DATA-002` | warning | test-data | Placeholder test data | A REPLACE_/TBD/CHANGEME value means the data was never supplied; the test cannot run meaningfully. |
| `DATA-003` | warning | test-data | Required data read with a non-null assertion | process.env.X! hides a missing variable until it crashes deep in a step with an unhelpful message. |
| `DATA-004` | warning | test-data | Hardcoded absolute URL | A fixed host ties the test to one environment; use baseURL or configuration. |
| `DATA-005` | info | test-data | fill() with an empty literal | Either data is missing or the intent is to clear the field. |
| `LOC-001` | warning | locator | XPath selector | XPath couples the test to document structure; role, label and test-id locators survive layout changes. |
| `LOC-002` | warning | locator | Positional or deeply nested selector | nth-child and long descendant chains break on any markup change. |
| `LOC-003` | warning | locator | Selector looks auto-generated | Hashed class names and numeric ids change on every build. |
| `LOC-004` | info | locator | first()/last()/nth() on an unscoped locator | Picking by position depends on DOM order and silences strict-mode ambiguity warnings. |
| `LOC-005` | warning | locator | Element handle API ($, $$) | Handles go stale when the page re-renders; locators re-resolve on every use. |
| `LOC-006` | info | locator | Legacy text=/css= selector engine string | getByText/getByRole express intent and give better error messages. |
| `HYG-001` | error | hygiene | .only left in | A committed .only silently skips every other test. |
| `HYG-002` | error | hygiene | page.pause() left in | pause() blocks forever in CI. |
| `HYG-003` | warning | hygiene | console.log in test code | Debug output; use test.step() or annotations for information that belongs in the report. |
| `HYG-004` | warning | hygiene | Test skipped without a reason | A skipped test with no explanation is lost coverage nobody remembers. |
| `HYG-005` | warning | hygiene | Swallowed failure (empty catch / .catch(() => {})) | Hides the failure the test exists to find. |
| `SEC-001` | error | security | Secret-shaped literal | Looks like an API key, token or private key committed to the repo. |
